## Prompt

> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write about times my expectations did not match reality

1. Almost all of Thursday. On Wednesday night, Sam and I got into a big fight that really drained me and I still planned a full day for Thursday.
2. On Friday, I planned to catch up on what I missed on Thursday, but I did not have time because I had to prepare for shabbat.
3. I thought two days would be enough for my Python project, but I barely finished.
4. Yesterday, I thought I would have enough time to review Python after SQL, but I did not even finish SQL.
5. In general, I have not been planning my days with consideration for my slower typing speed.
